name: Runner Extras - Codeunit.Run Guard Semantics
brief: Regression test: guarded Codeunit.Run traps the inner error and returns false; unguarded Codeunit.Run propagates it.
description: Proves the runner honours BC's guarded/unguarded Codeunit.Run distinction. When the boolean return is consumed (if/assignment) the inner error is trapped and Run returns false (readable via GetLastErrorText). When the return value is discarded (statement form) the inner error propagates to the caller.
